issues.description: The corner-radius system is visibly reversed: the source cards use restrained rounded corners while the render makes all three cards much rounder, and the source footer is a full pill while the render gives it shallow rounded corners. This changes the defining shape language across all primary containers.

changes.cards: Reduce the three card corner radii to the source's modest rounding.
changes.footer_bar: Increase the footer radius to a fully pill-shaped end cap.

issues.description: The rendered title sits slightly higher and the subtitle slightly lower and wider, leaving a noticeably looser title-to-subtitle gap than in the source.

changes.font_metrics: Slightly reduce subtitle width or size to match the source line length.
changes.position: Move the subtitle upward to restore the source's tighter title/subtitle rhythm.

issues.description: The footer slogan is visibly larger and wider in the render, producing heavier emphasis and less horizontal breathing room than the source.

changes.font_size: Reduce slightly until the rendered line length and weight match the source.

background_seams.rationale: The pale page background and both decorative corner circles remain continuous without hard rectangular seams or mismatched surface colors.

connector_endpoints.rationale: The source contains no connector endpoints or arrowheads.

connector_topology.rationale: The source contains no connectors, branches, merges, or cyclic relationships.

crop_boundaries.rationale: No raster assets or unintended opaque crop rectangles are visible; the clipped decorative circles retain clean native-shape edges.

key_proportions.rationale: The three cards, badges, background circles, and footer occupy the same major regions and preserve the source's overall visual balance.

typography_hierarchy.rationale: The hierarchy remains readable, but the title/subtitle spacing and the footer slogan scale do not match the source closely enough.

visual_depth.rationale: The source is intentionally flat, and the render preserves its pastel fills, subtle card outlines, divider hierarchy, and layered corner decoration without unintended flattening or added shadows.
